skills._comment: #474 THE COMPANION COUNTER (user ruling 2026-08-14, docs/CHOICE-LOG.md: 'The Warden gains a COUNTER to companions, not a companion nerf: the wolf is worth +0.79 there but is the spine's identity, and a boss that can threaten a companion generalises to every future one.'). It is authored ONCE, here, and carried by the apex body of the three fights a companion was measured to trivialise -- seal_warden, raskghar_awakened, shield_spider_matriarch. WHAT MAKES IT GENERAL: `target_rule: bonded` names a ROLE, never an id, so the day a second companion ships it meets this Skill on the day it ships, and a boss authored tomorrow answers every companion by carrying one line. WHAT MAKES IT SAFE FOR EVERY OTHER BUILD: `resolve_active` REFUSES it against a body that is not bonded, so a companionless spine fights the identical fight it fought before -- measured, not asserted: every non-companion cell at all three encounters reads byte-identical across this change (lane report). NOT A DELETE BUTTON: 1.6x on a 2-round cooldown is roughly one extra wolf-scale wound every other round, so the second body still buys the turns it is meant to buy and still dies to a boss that decides to kill it. Sized by A/B at 100 seeds -- see the lane report for the mult/cooldown ladder.

skills._comment: #460 THE SUMMON, the archetype's one new engine effect. ENEMY-KIT ONLY -- no class grants it, so data_lint files it under the `enemy-kit only` reachability CATEGORY, as guarding_ward/raskghar_maul/slam already are. AP-ONLY by design: the Lich's two bolts share one MP pool, and a raising that competed with them would make the archetype's signature the first thing a long fight stopped showing. cooldown/fight_limit/count/ap are BALANCE-MEASURED, not picked, and `tests/sim_summon_ceiling.gd` re-derives every number here on demand: the row as first authored (cd 2 / limit 3 / con 26) reads 0.85 competent-at-band -- ON the window ceiling -- with its fully-raised board at 0.29, through the floor, which is the case spec sec.3.3 rules by LOWERING THE LIMIT. Shipped reads 0.76 with the allowance spent in 100/100 seeds, and its fully-raised board at 0.74. These four are the only tuning levers this archetype has; shared stat rows are never one of them.

A distinct id IS the per-context override (combatants.json's convention since :468), applied to a Skill. Shape is [Bone Dart]'s verbatim. skills._comment: [SKIRMISHER] L14 grant (#438 KIT GAP; user ruling 2026-08-13, docs/CHOICE-LOG.md 'Skirmisher walls are a kit/Skill gap -- fill the kit'). THE DOCTRINE ANSWER to a class that walled at the Act V alcove (band-competent 0.26 over 100 seeds) while every sibling consolidation cleared it. MEASURED CAUSE, not inferred -- `tests/_kit_probe.gd`, 100 seeds, competent policy, act5_seal_warden: FIVE of the nine derived Act V spine builds stand at exactly 48 max HP -- spellsword, spellspear, deathknight, ranger, and this class before this lane -- and among THAT family the ones that WIN are the ones carrying an effective-HP buffer on top of it. The other four are not 48 and are not part of this read (measured: innkeeper 52, wild_sage 52, druid 52, scout 38); the claim is deliberately scoped to the builds that were measured rather than asserted of the whole table. [Spellsword]/[Spellspear]/[Deathknight] each hold [Mana Shield] backed by a 19-point MP pool (67 effective HP; 0.70 / 0.60 / 0.66), [Druid]/[Wild Sage] field a second body. The two martial spines with NEITHER -- this class at 0.26 and [Ranger] at 0.33 -- are precisely the two that wall. WHY [MANA SHIELD] CANNOT BE THE REMEDY HERE, and this is the whole reason a new id exists rather than a re-grant of the [Deathknight] answer: `wi_combat.gd` sets `max_mp` only when the kit holds a skill carrying `mp_cost`, and the spearmaster x archer lineage ships not one at any level -- so the Skill is INERT on this class. Measured, not argued: granting it reads 0.26 -> 0.26 with mp 0. THE MECHANISM THE HP BUYS is a step, not a slope. `WICombatPolicies._survive`'s hit floor is 1.5x the biggest hit any living foe could land, and the warden's is `int((str 17 / 2 + die 8) * power_strike 2.0)` == 32, so the floor is 48.0 -- EQUAL to this build's max HP. `hp <= hit_floor` is therefore true at FULL HEALTH: the tape shows round 1 spent on [Second Wind] healing 0 and burning its `once_per_fight`, which is why ablating [Second Wind] moves this BUILD by exactly 0.00 (and it must be said as a build, not as a cell: the SAME cell moves +0.18 on the shipped 58-HP skirmisher and -0.02 on the steel thread's own 52-HP ship_act5). Ten points of max HP put the opening bell above that floor, and the same tape then spends round 1 fighting and round 2 healing a real 8. Sized by the A/B rather than by feel: +4 reads 0.45, +8 reads 0.56 (a hair over the window floor), +12 reads 0.68. REFUTED ALTERNATIVES, all measured at the same cell so the record carries its own reproducer: mobility/disengage (+[Shadowstep] 0.26, +[Double Step] 0.26), a volley shape (+[Instantaneous Barrage] 0.26 -- the alcove fields ONE foe and `_nuke_area` requires two), more damage (+[Keener Point] 0.26; ABLATING [Spear Flurry] reads 0.30), more accuracy (+[Eagle Eyes] 0.29), and an escape (+[Invisibility] 0.13 -- actively worse, it buys a turn-costing survive action). THE TWIN DISCIPLINE: `ap_cost` and the effect block are [Tough Body]'s VERBATIM (hp_bonus 10, ap_cost 0); only id, name and prose re-flavor. `weapon` is MIRRORED and not minted -- [Tough Body] carries no gate, so this carries none, and deliberately: a spear gate would strip the class's only defensive answer on the bow half of its own lineage. No icon -- and the honest derivation is the hp_bonus FAMILY, not 0-AP passives at large: all four of tough_body, witchs_warding, pack_bond_boon and give_ground carry none, while 9 of the 27 records carrying an EXPLICIT `ap_cost: 0` DO have icons (eagle_eyes and shadowstep among them, two of the alternatives refuted below) -- and on the other reading of that denominator, counting the 57 records that omit `ap_cost` entirely and which the engine also reads as 0, it is 59 of 84. The conclusion holds either way; the explicit-key count is the one quoted here. What actually spares this record a sprites.json row is `check_skill_icons`, which gates on `field: true`; this skill has no `field` key. CANON: [Give Ground] is an ORIGINAL name, wiki-verified CLEAR 2026-08-13 (wiki.wanderinginn.com full-text search for "Give Ground" returns "There were no results matching the query"). The attested [Skirmisher] Skills inside the Book-17 bar were checked first and all three REJECTED on shape, not on the bar: [Surefoot] (Ksmvr, 6.67) is canonically footing on unstable ground, which the shipped [Even Footing] already occupies; [Evasive Flip] (Ksmvr, 6.67) is an active acrobatic dodge with no 0-AP engine shape; [Threefold Shot] (7.59) is a bow volley, which `weapon_gated_kit` strips at the spear this spine measures. All three are reported to the user for the naming batch. FINALLY, THE ACT II CELL, because an earlier draft of this record got its reason wrong and a future [Ranger] lane will read this: `act2_cistern_nest` (0.40) is NOT unreachable. Nothing on the skirmisher TABLE reaches it -- Acts I-IV are measured on the PARENT lines -- but a grant on `archer` at L<=2 does, and [Keen Eye] proves an [Archer] grant can be ungated and still field at a spear, while a spear-GATED one would be stripped from `ranger`/`scout` (bow at all five acts) so no sibling need move. The reason it stays open is OVERSHOOT on this spine's own cells: the same +10 HP reaching each cell reads act2 0.40 -> 0.67 and act4 0.80 -> 0.83 (both in window) but act3 0.72 -> 0.88, above the 0.85 ceiling, and act1 0.79 -> 0.96 if carried on the spearmaster side. Reachable, but not without breaking two other cells on this spine -- so it needs its own ruling and a differently-sized grant. ONE MORE THING FOR WHOEVER SIZES THAT GRANT: an `archer` L<=2 rung does not stop at Acts II-IV -- it also reaches ACT V through `inherits` (act5's kit already contains keen_eye), where it would stack on the give_ground shipped here. Price it against 58 max HP, not 48.
